description: Upload the video cover (start thumbnail) — the image shown before the user presses play. Provide `image_url` pointing to a publicly reachable image (PNG/JPG/WEBP); the tool downloads it and uploads as multipart to the Panda API. Replaces any existing start thumbnail. After this returns, the cover is active immediately for the player.

image_url.description: Public URL of the image to use as the cover

name: panda_add_thumbnail
title: Add Start Thumbnail (Cover)
